info.title: mushpi-server
info.description: A backend for the Mushroom Pi project

tags.name: monitoring
tags.description: Check the health of the microservice and it's dependencies

seconds.description: Total time the server has been running in seconds

minutes.description: Total time the server has been running in minutes

hours.description: Total time the server has been running in hours

days.description: Total time the server has been running in days

environment.description: The environment in which this instance of the service is being executed

loadAverage.description: Basic estimation of the system's memory load

read.description: Check that the provided credentials have read privileges

write.description: Check that the provided credentials have write privileges

hasKey.description: Check if theres a key to stablish communications with the service

available.description: Check if the service is reachable

responseTimeInMs.description: If the service is reachable, the time it takes to provide a response

databases.description: Check any database that the microservice needs to operate

handle.description: Handle (mDNS name) of the Pico unit to add manually

address.description: Local mDNS address for the pico unit's REST API

ipAddress.description: IP-based address for the pico unit (fallback)

latest_reading.description: Latest reading row for this unit (computed, not stored)

handle.description: Name for the unit as it is stated in its own software. Should not be changed.

ip.description: IPv4 address where the Pico API is reachable. Provided by the unit on announcement.

micropython_version.description: Version tag for the Micropython executed by the unit

software_version.description: Version tag for the custom software executed by the unit

examples: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W with RP2350

board_total_mem_byte.description: Size of the unit's memory in bytes

board_total_fs_byte.description: Size of the unit's file system in bytes

mac.description: Physical MAC address of the unit

description.description: Optional notes about this particular unit.

enabled.description: A flag that is true if the unit is active and reachable.

face_color.description: Cosmetic hex color assigned to the unit (e.g. #4CAF50).

recipe_id.description: Optional recipe to use as a template. species, temperature_target and humidity_target will be copied from the recipe if not explicitly provided.

images_url.description: Absolute URLs to the batch images (computed)

status.description: Current status of the batch (computed from start_at and finish_at)

images_left.description: Number of images that can still be uploaded to this batch

image.description: Filename of the uploaded image or external URL

temperature.description: The temperature in Celsius degrees that we want the Pico Unit to maintain

humidity.description: The percentage of humidity that we want the Pico Unit to maintain

active_high.description: A flag that should be true if the relay's circuits are connected to the NO (Normally Open) port, and false if they are connected through NC (Normally Closed).

humidifier.description: A flag that should be true we want the humidifier to be ON

fan.description: A flag that should be true we want the fan to be ON

heater.description: A flag that should be true we want the heater to be ON

enabled.description: A flag that should be true if we want the Pico Unit to automatically turn on and off devices to meet the temperature and humidity goals.
